title: He Fired Me For Being Nice To Customers
script: My new store manager fired a cashier for approving one lenient return, then posted a memo demanding every return get processed exactly per written policy, no exceptions, no discretion, ever. Fine by me. I laminated the policy and followed it to the letter. Torn tag but missing receipt? Denied, per section four. Opened box, no receipt, forty seconds past the register close? Denied. A regular with six years of loyalty got the same cold no as a total stranger. Complaints piled up, corporate started calling, and the manager got summoned upstairs twice in one week. Three weeks later he tried returning his own broken espresso machine without a receipt. I smiled, pulled out the laminated sheet, and read section four out loud, word for word. He stood there speechless while the whole line behind him started clapping.
